messages:
maya: hey folks, first week here. trying to build the runtime from source and hit a linker relocation error after pulling/building cutlass. any quick tips?

maya: error snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: libcutlass.a(reduction.o): relocation R_X86_64_32S against `.rodata' can not be used when making a shared object; recompile with -fPIC
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

maya: host is Ubuntu 22.04, gcc 12.2, CUDA 12.0 (runfile install), driver 535.54. cmake auto-detected /usr/local/cuda.

natanael: welcome! that error usually means a static library you're linking was built without -fPIC. did you build cutlass/faiss locally or use prebuilt artifacts?

maya: built cutlass and some in-repo microkernels locally with plain `make` after following README. repo cmake sets BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON.

paige: we typically set `-DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON` at the top-level so all static libs get PIC. Try reconfiguring with: `cmake .. -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON` and rebuild cutlass. Alternatively add `CXXFLAGS="-fPIC"` when invoking make for older Makefiles.

natanael: +1. also double-check `CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS` for overrides. If you're using our dev image this is preconfigured.

devopsbot: CI tip: use redwood/dev-runtime:2025-04 for local parity — common libs (cutlass/faiss) are built with PIC and matching toolchain. See https://ci.redwood.com/dev-images/runtime for details.

maya: i added -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON and rebuilt cutlass. linking got further but then failed with a libstdc++ symbol version error: `undefined symbol: _ZSt4cout@@GLIBCXX_3.4` when loading libruntime.so

rosie: that's a libstdc++ ABI/version mismatch. likely some deps were built with a different gcc version (libstdc++ ABI tags differ). what does `ldd build/lib/libruntime.so` show for libstdc++?

maya: `ldd build/lib/libruntime.so` shows libstdc++.so.6 -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 (gcc 12 on my host) but i suspect cutlass artifacts were built with gcc 11 in CI.

samir: we've seen this a lot. solution: build everything with the same compiler. on your machine try `sudo update-alternatives --set gcc /usr/bin/gcc-11` and `CC=gcc-11 CXX=g++-11 cmake ..` or use the dev image. Rebuilding deps with gcc-11 should fix symbol versions.

maya: switched to gcc-11, rebuilt cutlass with `CXXFLAGS="-fPIC"`, re-ran cmake and link — success! runtime starts and the GPU smoke test passes.

natanael: awesome. could you please add a short note to onboarding docs about PIC and toolchain alignment? Key bullets: ensure `CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON` when building shared libs, rebuild static deps with `-fPIC`, and keep gcc versions aligned (use our dev image when possible).

maya: done — added a small section in onboarding-docs: `runtime/building.md`. thanks for the help :tada:

paige: welcome aboard — happy to pair on CI caching for cutlass if you want to speed up iteration.

maya: appreciate it, i'll reach out. closing thread.
